Select distinct molecule chembl_id, compound name, and canonical SMILES for compounds linked to document CHEMBL1140357. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id filtering by doc chembl_id. Join compound_structures on molregno to enforce SMILES availability and retrieve canonical SMILES. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
